evals.name: cuts-and-hook-silent-render
evals.prompt: Вот отрендеренный ролик <VIDEO> (моушен-графика, без звука). Озвучь его реальными звуками из моих библиотек: свуши на склейки, хиты на тяжёлые моменты, UI-звуки на появление элементов. Мне нужен новый mp4 и отдельный wav.
evals.expected_output: New mp4 with SFX on the cuts and appearances, a separate wav, a cue report, critique scoreboard with every axis >= 8, no synthesized sound.
assertions: Output mp4 has the original video stream and an audio stream, same duration (+-0.2 s)
A separate WAV with the SFX is delivered
There is a sound within the first 2 seconds
At least 80% of strong cuts have a sound within 120 ms
No sound is synthesized (every sound is a library file or a uisfx cue)
True peak is at or below -1 dBTP
The run used verify and critique before presenting, and reported scores

evals.name: voiceover-keep-and-duck
evals.prompt: Ролик <VIDEO> с дикторским голосом. Добавь звуковой дизайн реальными звуками, голос должен остаться чистым и разборчивым.
evals.expected_output: Voice-over preserved (correlation with source > 0.9 outside SFX), SFX ducked under speech (--voice-safe), SFX 6-10 dB below the voice, no ambience bed.
assertions: Original voice audio is present in the output
--voice-safe (or equivalent ducking) was used
SFX are quieter than the original audio by 3-11 LU
No ambience bed is placed under speech
Separate WAV delivered

evals.name: music-led-beat-snap
evals.prompt: Ролик <VIDEO> под музыку. Добавь звуки на склейки и акценты, музыку оставь, попади в бит там, где это уместно.
evals.expected_output: Music kept, beats detected, hits snapped to the beat when within 50 ms, no extra rhythmic layer on top of the music.
assertions: Original music is preserved
beats.py was used and its usable flag respected
Hits within 50 ms of a beat are on the beat (or the reason for not snapping is given)
Music is ducked or SFX trimmed so the SFX do not bury it

evals.name: hyperframes-native-clips
evals.prompt: Вот проект HyperFrames <PROJECT>. Добавь звуки прямо в композицию, чтобы они переживали перерендер.
evals.expected_output: Moments read from the composition (no frame analysis), clips exported to assets/sfx, <audio> elements with ids and data-start/data-duration, no composition rule broken.
assertions: from_hyperframes.py was used rather than frame analysis
Every <audio> has a unique id
Overlapping audio clips use different data-track-index values
Processed clips are files in assets/sfx and referenced with relative paths
The agent asked before calling another skill or running render
